Description: The collector shall record host and eligible-process CPU observations using supported read-only Linux interfaces and preserve the source and unit for each value.
Verification method: Inspect a captured run; verify source, unit, timestamp, and host/process scope for every emitted CPU field.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The collector shall record available host and eligible-process memory observations and mark each metric with its source, unit, and scope.
Verification method: Compare emitted fields with the selected Linux interface; verify unavailable values are statused rather than represented as zero.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The collector shall record available host and eligible-process I/O observations with device or cgroup scope and interval context where the source requires deltas.
Verification method: Inspect consecutive samples and confirm scope, units, interval, and counter-reset behavior are preserved.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: When supported by the running kernel and target, the collector shall read CPU, memory, and I/O Pressure Stall Information and identify unsupported or inaccessible resources.
Verification method: On a host with supported PSI, demonstrate readings; on unavailable or denied sources, verify an explicit quality state.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Optional eBPF collection shall remain disabled unless a fixed probe set has been reviewed, configured, and approved for the target kernel.
Verification method: Inspect the default service configuration and verify no probe attaches unless the approved profile is selected.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Each sample shall carry a UTC timestamp and a monotonic ordering value sufficient to detect ordering across wall-clock adjustment.
Verification method: Simulate or inspect wall-clock adjustment while confirming monotonic sample order is preserved.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: A process-scoped observation shall include PID and process start-time identity so a reused PID is not treated as the same process instance.
Verification method: Exercise process exit and PID reuse or a controlled fixture; confirm prior identity and action context are not reused.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Before inference or policy evaluation, the pipeline shall validate required field shape, unit, source health, and counter-delta validity.
Verification method: Submit malformed, unit-mismatched, reset, and source-error samples; each is rejected or marked unusable with a reason.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The pipeline and read-only view shall distinguish measured zero from unavailable, permission-denied, stale, warming-up, and degraded data states.
Verification method: For each quality state, verify stored/viewed output does not collapse it into measured zero.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: A reset counter, missing interval, stale sample, or changed process identity shall invalidate dependent deltas and prevent those values from authorizing an action.
Verification method: Inject reset, missing interval, stale age, and identity change; verify LEAVE/deny and no OS write.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Accepted telemetry shall be stored locally in SQLite for bounded inspection and recent-window access.
Verification method: Inspect a run database and confirm accepted samples can be queried by run/time without an external service.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Telemetry retention, database size, and SQLite write-ahead-log growth shall be bounded by reviewed host-local settings.
Verification method: Run a retention/size scenario; verify cleanup and cap behavior and report the selected settings.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Dashboard data access shall use a read-only projection and shall not receive the actuator socket or cgroup write permission.
Verification method: Inspect service permissions and attempt write/control operations through the dashboard boundary; both must be unavailable.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The telemetry-to-inference boundary shall pass approved observations and receive generic prediction outputs without prescribing model type, algorithm, or internals.
Verification method: Review the shared interface with AI owners; confirm no model-specific field or algorithm assumption is imposed by this SRS.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: A prediction used for a decision shall remain associated with its source window and available time/quality context; exact fields and schema require team agreement.
Verification method: Trace one output to its input window and freshness context without requiring a physical schema in this SRS.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Inference outputs shall not write to the operating system or call the privileged actuator directly.
Verification method: Inspect process permissions and exercise an inference output; only the decision/policy path may submit a bounded request.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: For each eligible process and evaluated window, the decision service shall produce LEAVE or a proposal/denial outcome with a reason.
Verification method: Inspect outcomes for safe no-op, insufficient evidence, and eligible proposals; each must have a reason and target context.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Before admitting a proposal, policy shall check operating mode, target eligibility, allowlist membership, evidence freshness, action bounds, and cooldown.
Verification method: Exercise each gate independently and in combination; any failed gate yields denial and no write.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: OBSERVE_ONLY shall be the default at first start and after restart, missing/invalid configuration, or failed safety health; no dashboard action shall enable control.
Verification method: Restart with absent, malformed, and valid reviewed host-local configuration; only the reviewed valid configuration may permit the proposed bounded profile.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: For every supported resource class, AIOS shall permit only bounded writes to preconfigured approved cgroups: cpu.weight for CPU, memory.high for RAM, and supported io.weight/io.max for I/O. Each resource requires independent capability and authorization checks; unsupported controls remain recommendation-only.
Verification method: Exercise CPU, RAM, and I/O controls independently on an isolated target. Verify unsupported controls produce no write and a recommendation; verify each supported control requires its own approved gate, bounds, target, and ownership checks.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: AIOS shall not write memory.max, terminate processes, invoke arbitrary shell commands, or write a control whose controller/device is unsupported or whose target is not approved. Denied or unavailable actions shall remain recommendations and be audited.
Verification method: Attempt every prohibited, unsupported, and unapproved action; verify no OS write occurs and the reason is recorded.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Decision/policy-to-actuator requests shall use a host-local Unix domain socket.
Verification method: Inspect runtime configuration and confirm the action path does not expose a network control endpoint.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The actuator shall authenticate the connecting local process with SO_PEERCRED and reject peers outside the reviewed local peer policy.
Verification method: Connect from an allowed and a disallowed peer; the latter must be rejected and audited.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Immediately before a write, the actuator shall revalidate request bounds, mode, allowlist, target cgroup, process-instance identity where applicable, and AIOS ownership.
Verification method: Change target identity/configuration after policy admission; actuator must reject the stale or mismatched request without writing.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: For every admitted resource-control write, the adapter shall capture the prior control value, apply only the bounded and authorized value, and read back the effective value. I/O values shall retain their device identity.
Verification method: For CPU, RAM, and each supported I/O control, compare target/device, prior, requested, and read-back values; verify denied writes do not change the host.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: If a write or verification fails, the adapter shall attempt only a guarded restoration of a still-verified AIOS-owned target and shall never invoke an arbitrary shell command.
Verification method: Inject write/read-back failure and target change; verify guarded restore only for the unchanged owned target, otherwise fail closed.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The audit path shall record decisions, denials, authentication/validation failures, action attempts, verification outcomes, and fallback events with correlation context.
Verification method: Trace a normal, denied, failed, and fallback scenario from input reference to outcome without asserting physical schema.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Audit records shall be appended to a hash-chained log whose verification can detect modification, missing links, or reset history.
Verification method: Alter, remove, and reset a test record; verification must flag each case and actuation must remain disabled pending review.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: A watchdog shall monitor service heartbeat and input freshness independently of the ordinary decision path.
Verification method: Stop a heartbeat and age input beyond the reviewed test threshold; verify watchdog detects both conditions.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: On stale evidence, watchdog failure, or unsafe state, AIOS shall block new OS writes, enter fallback, and record a reason.
Verification method: Inject each condition and verify no new write is admitted and an auditable fallback state is reported.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Fallback restoration shall use the captured prior resource-control value for a target whose cgroup identity and AIOS ownership still match; I/O restoration shall also match the recorded device. Read back and verify the restored value.
Verification method: Test restore for matching and changed targets/devices across supported controls. Restore only the still-matching AIOS-owned target; otherwise remain fail-closed and report degraded state.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The dashboard shall expose read-only status, recommendations, operating mode, service health, safety state, action outcomes, and audit summaries through projections.
Verification method: Demonstrate each view from read-only data and confirm no view requires a control call.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The dashboard shall provide no command, approval, policy edit, mode change, or resource-control operation, and shall not provide a path to the actuator socket.
Verification method: Review the UI, routes, service identity, and access rights; verify no control affordance or connection exists.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The dashboard shall present measured zero separately from unavailable, stale, degraded, warming-up, and denied data.
Verification method: Use fixtures for every data-quality state and verify distinct labels/visual states.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: systemd shall supervise proposed service lifecycle and expose service health/failure state to the read-only projection.
Verification method: Stop/restart each proposed service and verify supervision and health reporting without enabling actuation.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: As an optional host-local profile, selected non-safety AIOS compute services may be restricted to a host-selected set of online logical CPUs; the effective mask shall be checked.
Verification method: Compare configured and effective CPU masks under parent restrictions; report unsupported or empty masks and return to the safe profile.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: As an optional host-local profile, CPUQuota/cpu.max may cap aggregate CPU time for selected non-safety AIOS compute services; the watchdog, policy, and actuator shall not receive an unvalidated tight quota.
Verification method: Inspect the effective quota and measure heartbeat/fallback under the reviewed profile; report quota as a ceiling, not reserved CPU capacity.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: AIOS shall report Ubuntu, kernel, cgroup-v2, PSI, and optional eBPF prerequisites and shall disable or degrade unsupported features explicitly.
Verification method: Run with supported and unsupported prerequisites; verify reported state and safe fallback for each optional feature.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Service permissions shall follow least privilege; only the narrow actuator process may receive the approved cgroup write permission.
Verification method: Inspect process identities, file permissions, and cgroup access; attempt an unauthorized write from other services.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Collector, inference, decision/policy, actuator, audit, and dashboard access shall be separated at the process/interface boundary appropriate to the deployed profile.
Verification method: Review the deployment and verify each component has only the required read/write interfaces.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The system shall make audit-chain breaks, missing history, resets, or unverifiable events visible and disable actuation until review.
Verification method: Introduce each integrity failure; verify visible state and no further action admission.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Invalid, stale, unauthenticated, out-of-bounds, wrong-target, or integrity-failed evidence shall produce LEAVE/deny and no OS write.
Verification method: Run the negative safety acceptance suite and confirm zero accepted disallowed writes.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Failure of AIOS services shall not replace Linux-native scheduling or memory-management behavior; watchdog/control shall remain outside any unvalidated CPU cap.
Verification method: Stop or constrain each service in a controlled host run; record native behavior, watchdog freshness, and foreground effect.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: A service restart shall not enable control unless the reviewed host-local configuration and required safety health are valid.
Verification method: Restart from missing, invalid, and valid reviewed configurations; verify safe mode is retained in the first two cases.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Evaluation records shall include AIOS CPU use, RSS, storage and write rate, sample freshness, decision latency, and foreground workload impact.
Verification method: Produce a benchmark record containing each named measure and the baseline/configuration metadata.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Sampling, staleness, latency, storage, and control thresholds shall be approved from target-host measurements before active control is enabled.
Verification method: Review recorded baseline, percentile calculations, and owner approval before any control profile is enabled.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: By default, telemetry and dashboard projections shall use an opaque host alias and process identity; command lines, environment variables, usernames, filesystem paths, and payload contents shall be omitted.
Verification method: Inspect captured records and dashboard output for prohibited fields; verify host alias use.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The deployment shall report prerequisite availability by Ubuntu/kernel/cgroup/PSI/eBPF capability and shall not silently assume every optional interface exists.
Verification method: Inspect compatibility report on target and on a configuration lacking an optional interface.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The read-only view shall visibly distinguish observation, prediction/recommendation, admitted action, denial, and fallback outcome without offering user control.
Verification method: Task-based comprehension review with intended viewers; verify each state is correctly identified and no control path is exposed.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: The design shall keep telemetry collection, validation, inference adaptation, decision policy, IPC, actuation, persistence, audit, watchdog, and dashboard query responsibilities separately reviewable.
Verification method: Architecture review maps each responsibility to a bounded component and a documented interface; exact class/API signatures remain implementation decisions.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Description: Each leaf requirement shall have a planned verification method and a status that separates proposed design, implemented behavior, and collected evidence.
Verification method: Audit the requirements register; every row has a verification method and truthful status/evidence reference.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending

Requirement_Name: Separate Technical Evidence from Demand Evidence
Description: Market needs shall remain hypotheses until local participant evidence is collected and reviewed; technical documentation shall not be presented as proof of demand or benefit.
Verification method: Review market matrix and reports; verify no demand, prevalence, willingness-to-pay, or benefit claim is labeled validated without primary evidence.
Status: Draft; team review and acceptance evidence pending
